findings.issue: Mandatory PK paths point at non-existent files. Task 13 lists `[project.md](../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/project.md)`, `[architecture.md](../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/architecture.md)`, `[patterns.md](../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/patterns.md)`, `[deployment.md](../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/deployment.md)` — but the actual files live under `.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/` (verified via filesystem: only `references/` subfolder exists, no top-level *.md files). project.md and architecture.md are mandatory context files, so broken links to them are critical.
findings.fix: Insert `references/` segment in all four PK links: `../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md`, `.../architecture.md`, `.../patterns.md`, `.../deployment.md`. Match the path style already used correctly by Task 11.

findings.issue: PK paths are root-relative (`.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md`) instead of feature-relative (`../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md`). From the task file's location (`work/06-bot-connection/tasks/12.md`), markdown renderers that resolve links relative to the file will fail to find these paths; only renderers that resolve from CWD will work. Inconsistent with Task 11 in the same batch, which uses the `../../../` prefix correctly.
findings.fix: Prefix all PK paths with `../../../`: `[project.md](../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md)`, same for architecture.md and patterns.md.

findings.issue: Skill link is root-relative: `[skills/test-master/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/test-master/SKILL.md)`. From the task file's location this does not resolve to the actual SKILL.md. Inconsistent with Task 11 which uses `../../../.claude/skills/security-auditor/SKILL.md` (feature-relative) correctly.
Skill link `[skills/pre-deploy-qa/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/pre-deploy-qa/SKILL.md)` is root-relative and does not resolve from the file's location. Inconsistent with Task 11.

Frontmatter declares `verify: []` but Verification Steps has a populated `### Smoke` subsection with four concrete smoke checks (local boot with/without key, curl bean-validation 400, mongo indexes, fail-fast key check). Per task-creator rules, `verify` derives from presence of smoke/user blocks — `verify` should be `[smoke]`.
findings.fix: Change frontmatter to `verify: [smoke]`. Or, if the intent is that those are internal QA steps not external verification gates, drop the `### Smoke` subsection.

findings.issue: `### User` subsection is present with text `Not applicable for this task...`. Template rule: `Omit section if no user checks`. An explicit "not applicable" stub is not the prescribed pattern.
findings.fix: Delete the `### User` subsection entirely. Move the post-deploy explanation into Details / Notes or the Description.

findings.issue: Reviewers body uses `_None — Audit Wave tasks have no reviewers._`, which is acceptable, but other tasks in this batch (12, 13) phrase the same idea differently. Stylistic, not a defect — flagged for awareness only.
findings.fix: Optional: align phrasing across audit/QA tasks if a house style is desired. No functional change required.

findings.issue: AC4 (nine focus areas) is a nested bullet list rather than nine separate `- [ ]` checklist items. Template prefers each criterion as its own `- [ ]` line so reviewers can tick them individually. Current form mixes a top-level `- [ ]` with nine sub-bullets — minor readability/checkability hit.
findings.fix: Either keep the nested form (and accept the minor finding) or split the nine focus areas into nine `- [ ]` checklist items at the top level. Functionality is unchanged.

findings.issue: Automated subsection is light: only two `grep` sanity checks and a note that the audit is documentation-only. For an audit task this is reasonable, but the wording "should reveal any sleep usage" describes an expectation, not an executable assertion an agent can pass/fail. No file-existence check on the produced audit report.
findings.fix: Add an executable existence check, e.g. `test -s work/06-bot-connection/logs/working/task-12/test-audit-report.md` — mirroring Task 11's first Automated check. Keeps the existing grep hints.
